cases.provenance: A user reported this defect after the reviewed pull request, and a later fix repaired it.
cases.description:
I've got a panic in embassy-rp's uartrx.read_to_break.
[Line 608](https://github.com/embassy-rs/embassy/blob/main/embassy-rp/src/uart/mod.rs#L608) returns a usize that is calculated through doing `(next_addr - 1) - sval`, however in my case it appears that both `next_addr` and `sval` are the same value meaning that with the minus one we try to return `-1` as usize.
There is a check [a few lines above](https://github.com/embassy-rs/embassy/blob/main/embassy-rp/src/uart/mod.rs#L588) which checks if `next_addr` is smaller than `sval` but it doesn't check if they are the same

evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
Fix underflow in embassy-rp uartrx.read_to_break

This fixes #2490.

In rare cases the line break can be triggered without any data having been read which causes both `next_addr` and `sval` to be the same value. Subtracting 1 and `sval` from `next_addr` causes an underflow panic in debug mode and  a high chance of panic in release mode when the user uses the returned `usize::Max` value to try and index their data
